subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Migration is not only movement.”?
options: It is loss and beginning together.
Human activity can interrupt conversations we are only beginning to understand.
I still miss home, but I am beginning to understand why people like camp.
Sometimes it begins with a button.
